summary: Final validated architecture specification for Paperwork incorporating all 9 final validation requirements: PdfEngine abstraction & verified androidx.pdf:1.0.0-beta01 requirements, non-rasterizing PDFBox page manipulation with original preservation & validation, versioned AES-256-GCM encryption header with unique 12-byte IVs & KeyInfo security level detection (without flash-erase claims), BiometricPrompt/device-credential & PIN access lock separation, robust PrintDocumentAdapter lifecycle & reverse page sequence spooling, full scanner pipeline with manual 4-corner perspective & deskew, SAF/Share & large-image conversion resilience, reconciled Compose BOM & clean dependency catalog, custom Paperwork stacked-layers logo integration, and 6 independently testable milestones.
